olivia: follow-up from today’s all-hands — can runtime/kernel leads post a short bullet timeline, the default adaptive-batching + kv-cache settings well document, and the circuit-breaker/rollback plan? product/docs need blurb.

james: kernel lead here. TL;DR: alpha->staging in 3 days, 1 week soak, 10% prod canary for 2 weeks, wide rollout in week 5 if green. Branch `adaptive-batching-v1` commit 9b7c6a.

sofia: will there be any changes customers must opt into? docs want exact flags.

james: Defaults we recommend shipping: `batching.mode=adaptive`, `batching.max_size=64`, `batching.latency_target_ms=20`, `cache.prefix.enabled=true`, `cache.level=hot,warm`, `cache.ttl_ms=45000`. Add per-route `kernels.opt_enabled=true/false`.

amir: any special notes for short-interaction workloads? we've had complaints about grouping causing small jitter.

james: adaptive mode favors latency for small sessions; if a route is <5ms median so prefer `batching.mode=single` in config. We'll add sample configs.

noah: telemetry: we'll add metric `kernel.circuit_state` and traces for `batch.window_ms`. Default trace sampling 12% hosted, off for Dedicated. Note: metric cardinality +3-6%.

tara: rollback/circuit-breaker: automated circuit trips if canary_quality_drop >0.6% OR p99 latency > baseline*1.3 for 10m. When tripped we disable opt kernels and revert batching.mode to `single` for the route. Hosted rollback is automatic; Dedicated gets a manual knob.

sofia: Action items: docs blurb + sample configs (sofia), canary evals + customer prompt list (amir), telemetry sampling + dashboards (noah), rollback runbook (james). I'll draft release note and ping product.
